next_actions.question: deed
next_actions.wording: Is there a recorded deed reference, and if so, what does it document?
next_actions.what: Pull the latest deed at the Circuit Clerk
next_actions.why: Vesting owner, legal description and instrument number come only from the recorded deed. Now: no automated source; a person does this.
next_actions.resolves: Deed book/page or instrument number, grantor/grantee, record date

next_actions.question: state_history
next_actions.wording: Is there a State sale or redemption record for this parcel?
next_actions.what: Check the State's sale and redemption reports for the county
next_actions.why: History explains prior certifications and redemptions. Now: the sources that answered did not establish it.
next_actions.resolves: A State report line for this parcel

next_actions.question: collector_asof
next_actions.wording: When did the county Collector last answer for this parcel, and what did it say?
next_actions.what: Ask the Collector when it last answered for this parcel
next_actions.why: An old answer is treated as unknown after 45 days. Now: the automated source did not answer.

next_actions.question: inspection
next_actions.wording: Has a person inspected the property in person, and what did they record?
next_actions.what: Inspect the property in person: exterior, visible structure, occupancy indicators, posted notices, apparent access
next_actions.why: Condition and occupancy are never inferred from records. Now: no automated source; a person does this.
next_actions.resolves: Your dated inspection log with photos

next_actions.question: lien_clerk
next_actions.wording: Is there a recorded mortgage, judgment or tax lien at the Circuit Clerk?
next_actions.what: Search the Circuit Clerk index for mortgages, judgments and tax liens
next_actions.why: Recorded liens follow the property. Now: no automated source; a person does this.
next_actions.resolves: A Clerk index result naming any instruments, or a dated 'none found'

next_actions.question: title
next_actions.wording: Is there a title search or Circuit Clerk index result on record?
next_actions.what: Order or run a title search at the Circuit Clerk
next_actions.why: Property Hunter never declares title clear; only a search does. Now: no automated source; a person does this.
next_actions.resolves: A title search result or Circuit Clerk index review, recorded as a manual verification
